final: WITH g AS (SELECT ft.account_id AS account_id, c.town_city AS town_city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY ft.account_id, c.town_city), t AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g GROUP BY town_city), m AS (SELECT g.account_id AS account_id, g.town_city AS town_city, g.cnt AS cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM g JOIN t ON g.town_city = t.town_city COLLATE BINARY), av AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM m) SELECT m.account_id, m.town_city, m.cnt, m.share, m.cnt * 1.0 / av.avg_cnt AS ratio_to_avg FROM m JOIN av ON av.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC LIMIT 10
